text: Finance Exception Intelligence.
zh: 财务异常智能。

text: Review monthly status.
zh: 查看月度监控状态。

text: Open Freight.
zh: 打开 Freight 预警。

text: A possible duplicate allocation needs finance review.
zh: 可能存在重复分摊，需财务核实。

text: Identify records, correct duplicates, rerun, and validate Freight and GP.
zh: 识别记录，修正重复分摊，重新运行，并验证 Freight 与毛利。

text: Review revenue, cost, and cost credit trends.
zh: 查看收入、成本和成本抵减趋势。

text: Open Service allocation.
zh: 打开 Service allocation。

text: GA shows negative month-three gross profit.
zh: GA 第三个月毛利为负。

text: Ask why gross profit turned negative.
zh: 询问毛利为什么转为负数。

text: Follow the rules, true-up, revenue base, and source evidence.
zh: 依次追踪规则、轧差、收入基数和源凭证。

text: Open the negative revenue voucher.
zh: 打开负收入凭证。

text: Check amount, segment, user and reference.
zh: 核对金额、segment、入账人和参考号。

text: No matching positive entry is confirmed.
zh: 本样例尚未确认匹配的正向凭证。

text: Compare excluding the voucher from the allocation base only.
zh: 比较仅将凭证排除在分摊基数之外的方案。

text: Posted revenue and months one and two stay unchanged.
zh: 已入账收入和前两个月的分摊结果不变。

text: GA improves, total gross profit is unchanged, and LE remains under review.
zh: GA 改善，但总毛利不变，LE 仍待核查。

text: Save the candidate and generate a report with evidence, assumptions, and actions.
zh: 保存候选方案，生成包含证据、假设和行动的报告。

text: Create a follow-up task from the same saved proposal.
zh: 从同一已保存方案创建后续任务。

text: Assign an owner.
zh: 分派负责人。

text: The assignee receives the task and starts work.
zh: 被指派人接收任务并开始工作。

text: Track each handoff.
zh: 追踪每次交接。

text: Record the outcome.
zh: 记录处理结果。

text: Task completion does not change the ledger.
zh: 任务完成不改变账务。

text: Ask about report logic.
zh: 询问报表逻辑。

text: The simulated answer streams from the selected knowledge base and links to its source.
zh: 模拟答案从所选知识库流式展示，并链接原文。

text: Explore built-in and personal knowledge.
zh: 查看内置和个人知识库。

text: Choose a report, dimension and metric.
zh: 选择报表、维度和指标。

text: Describe a monitor, then configure a gross-profit benchmark.
zh: 描述监控需求，再设置毛利阈值。

text: Add revenue trends, configure signals, rearrange cards, and reuse templates in Monitor Market.
zh: 添加收入趋势、配置信号、拖动卡片，并从 Monitor Market 复用模板。

text: Finance Exception Intelligence.
zh: 财务异常智能。

text: Sample data.
zh: 样例数据。

text: Simulated AI.
zh: 模拟 AI。
